summary.title: Animate SQL
summary.one_liner: An interactive web tool that visualizes what a chosen SQL keyword does by animating a query you pick from a dropdown.
takeaways: Choose a SQL keyword from the dropdown and press Visualize to see an animation of what it does.
You can customize queries to better understand how SQL behaves.
The tool is aimed at reviewing SQL concepts you have forgotten or find confusing.
The page suggests using a desktop or laptop for the best experience.
summary.summary: Animate SQL is a web tool for learning SQL through animation. The page text shows an editor-style interface with a dropdown of SQL keywords and a Visualize button that animates what the selected keyword does. Users can also customize queries to explore behavior further. The page text provides no further detail on supported databases, pricing, or implementation specifics.
